Guild Overview

Valor is the first successful Dungeon Runners Guild in the game. Implimented before in-game support for guilds/posses was developed, Valor has exceeded many people's expectations by surviving on and building a mature and stable guild community and atmosphere. Valor has been pioneering many ideas and concepts into Dungeon Runners, such as a guild bank, guild raiding, mass drop parties, and more!

Check out the main site located at http://www.valor-guild.net to learn more about the guild and how to apply to join us.

Latest News

Guild Meet 'N Greet Today! 4/20/08, 5:01 AM PST

Hey everyone,

The Valor 1st Guild Meet 'n Greet is today (Sunday the 20th) at 1:00 PM PST!

All Valor members are invited for a short afternoon of meeting other guildies, having a little guild pow-wow, boss farming, mini-games, and possibly even some PvP!

If you haven't already read about it, you can do so HERE

See you there!

- Theck
